## Findings

### Abstraction package
**`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`**

Defined in `/bench/repo/internal/idp/idp.go`. It holds the shared cross-protocol type `IdentityProviderUserInfo` (identifier, display name, email, avatar URL). There is no explicit Go `interface` in this package; the abstraction is the package plus that shared result type, which concrete providers return.

### Implementation package
**`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`**

Defined in `/bench/repo/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`. This is the only shipped protocol implementation. It provides an OAuth2 `IdentityProvider` with:
- `NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config)`
- `ExchangeToken(...)` — uses `golang.org/x/oauth2`
- `UserInfo(...)` — returns `*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo`

OAuth2 is the only supported IdP type in the schema (`OAUTH2 = 1` only) and the only subpackage under `internal/idp/`.

### Wiring evidence
SSO login dispatches on OAuth2 and constructs the concrete provider in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go`:

```119:134:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go
	var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
	if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
		oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
		// ...
		token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
		// ...
		userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
```
